mission: Continuously search for evidence-backed ways DreamCo can make humans more productive, make Buddy smarter, create software/tools/data products businesses will pay for, improve government/nonprofit workflows, and discover permitted revenue experiments.
cadence: continuous local/sandbox discovery with scheduled evidence review; external searches require current authorized sources and respect source/platform terms

questions: What recurring human work can be made faster, easier, safer or more accessible?
What handoff or duplicate entry can be removed?
What error can be prevented before it happens?
loops.output: benchmark cases and reusable tool proposals

questions: What failure pattern can become shared knowledge?
What routing/model/tool choice can improve?
What new benchmark exposes a blind spot?
What shared infrastructure improvement benefits many bots?
What repeated pain point can become reusable software?
What workflow requires several apps?
What internal DreamCo capability can become a customer product?
What data/skill package has measurable value?
loops.output: product hypothesis, buyer, MVP, benchmark and pricing experiment

questions: What step in starting, operating or expanding a business is costly or repetitive?
What can increase revenue or reduce cost/risk?
What can free owner or employee time?
What low-risk permitted digital work can be fulfilled with measurable customer value?
What tested product/service can be prepared for owner-approved live use?
loops.output: sandbox revenue experiment; no unsolicited spam, deceptive activity or guaranteed income

questions: What public-service workflow can save staff or residents time without automating consequential authority?
What administrative government task can be safely assisted?
What current procurement need could DreamCo credibly support?
What requirement reveals a capability gap worth building?
loops.output: opportunity-fit evidence and capability gap; never claim registration/certification not verified

questions: What nonprofit mission, fundraising, grant, volunteer, reporting or service-delivery workflow can be improved?

promotion_rule: Ideas remain hypotheses until evidence exists. Autonomous revenue remains sandboxed until permissions, fulfillment quality, payment/tax/compliance boundaries and owner-defined live controls are satisfied.
truth_rule: Discovery may run continuously, but value/revenue claims require evidence and consequential external actions require applicable user/owner approval plus legal/platform permission.
